summary: NIFTY (Quote) and NIFTY50 (LTP) both stream Kotak's Nifty 50: one index tick reaches both, releasing NIFTY keeps the name's feed for NIFTY50, and releasing NIFTY50 too unsubscribes it (audit P-05).

deviations.reason: An SFeed index packet carries no volume; the web's index normaliser writes volume 0 (sfeed_websocket.py::_to_index) and publishes it, a zero the exchange never sent. The desktop leaves it out (web openalgo#2376).

The web's Kotak adapter publishes the change as percent_change only (the packet's nc); the desktop also sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent. Kotak's entry turns them off once lane wire's per-broker key rule (decisions 9 Nov) is on the base.
